title: CASMI 2026: Molecule ID From Mass Spectra
headline: We are in the middle of the pack: about 600th of over five thousand teams, level with hundreds of others who run the same public method. We are now working out where that method's first answers go wrong, so we can pull clear of the tie.

board.metric: MRR@25 (mean reciprocal rank of the first correct molecule, top 25)

entries.note: total is the submission count on the board read of 12 November; how many were sent today is not recorded in the repository
